name: password-input
title: Password Input
description: UI SDK PasswordInput styled as a field: a reveal toggle as an icon button with a tooltip that keeps its name while aria-pressed says whether the password shows, floating labels and FormField binding.
docs: `<PasswordInput autoComplete>` in a `Field`: with no children it renders `PasswordInputControl` and `PasswordInputToggle`; compose them to pass input attributes such as `placeholder`. `autoComplete="current-password"` to sign in, `"new-password"` to sign up. The toggle is named "Show password" (override with `aria-label`) and keeps that name while `aria-pressed` says the password shows; the icon swaps between an eye and a struck eye. A pointer press keeps focus in the field. Submitting, resetting or leaving the page hides it again. `data-capslock` marks the field while Caps Lock is on, for a warning of your own. `labelPlacement="in"`/`"on"` float the Field's label, and `FormField` binds the value.
